title: Market Run, Week 5
dek: Sample waiver targets, plus what Monday night changed.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md: Sample week. FAAB ranges assume a 100-dollar budget.

adds.why: Bijan left Monday night with an ankle and Allgeier played every snap after. If Bijan misses time this is a top-12 RB week.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 25 to 35 percent of FAAB. Top priority if you are thin at RB.

adds.why: Ran 33 routes and drew 9 targets with Godwin out. Route share has climbed three weeks running.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 10 to 15 percent, in 12-team leagues and deeper.

adds.why: Route share over 70% two straight weeks and the red zone looks are coming.
adds.verdict: Stream him this week, 3 to 5 percent, if you are chasing a tight end.

stashes.why: Handcuff with standalone value if the split keeps tilting.

drops.why: Two straight games under 30% route share. The role is gone.

mnf.text: Monday night: the Falcons' Wednesday practice report decides how much to spend on Allgeier. The tape looked like a sprain, not a break. Monitor Bijan until Wednesday and claim Allgeier now either way.
